newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-DONADONI TO RETURN TO AC MILAN, NEWSPAPER SAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DONADONI TO RETURN TO AC MILAN, NEWSPAPER SAYS.

text.p: Veteran Italian midfielder Roberto Donadoni is set to return to champions AC Milan after a season in U.S. Major League Soccer, the sports daily Corriere dello Sport reported on Saturday.
The paper, which gave no source for its story, said Donadoni was due to return from holiday in about three weeks and would sign for his former club until June 1998.
Donadoni, 33, helped the struggling New York/New Jersey MetroStars reach the play-offs in the the new United States league this season.
He won medals for five serie A titles and three European Cup victories during his 10 seasons with Milan.
He was a regular in the national team for six years and one of the few successes in the side knocked out in the first round of June's European championship in England.
